card.title: A-26 INVADER
card.flavorText: The Douglas A-26 Invader was an American light bomber and ground attack aircraft, built by the Douglas Aircraft Company during WWII. The aircraft was first used in combat in 1944 in Europe, and then in the Pacific War in 1945. Although the service of the A-26 Invader was short in WWII, it was highly effective and was one of the finer aircraft developed during the war. A total of 2,503 aircraft were built, including variants, and it was used in service for many years after the war, both by the Americans and other countries.
